EDENOS MACHINE MODULE MODEL v0.1

MODULE CLASSES
Sensor; Actuator; Motion; Energy; Payload; Positioning; Communications; Safety; Compute; Storage; Service.

PAYLOAD CLASSES
0 Passive mechanical
1 Powered
2 Controlled
3 Sensed
4 Intelligent

MOBILITY PROVIDERS
Differential; Ackermann; tracked; articulated; legged; multirotor; fixed-wing; VTOL; surface vessel; underwater; stationary mechanism.

GENERIC MOTION/MISSION PRIMITIVES
stop; move; move_to; follow_route; hold_position; return_home; execute_payload_action.

LOCALIZATION STATE
Position + source + quality/confidence + age. Mission permissions may depend on localization quality.

CAPABILITY DEGRADATION
Loss of RTK may disable precision work while GNSS remains; loss of GNSS may retain Teach/Replay through odometry/IMU; further sensor failures progressively restrict operation toward safe manual/stop.

MODULE REPLACEMENT
DISCOVER → IDENTIFY → COMPARE → PROPOSE REPLACEMENT → TEST → CALIBRATE → ACCEPT.
Unknown hardware must not auto-actuate.
